labels.SAFE: local mitigation control, not a whole-program proof
labels.UNKNOWN: context or external contract is missing

samples.title: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
samples.label: VULN
samples.intent: Unbounded copy into a fixed-size stack buffer.

samples.title: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
samples.label: SAFE
samples.intent: Rejects input that cannot fit, including the terminator.

samples.title: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
samples.label: UNKNOWN
samples.intent: Safety depends on external capacity and function contracts.
